tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows mild hypoglycemia and slightly decreased total CO₂, which may suggest mild metabolic acidosis or compensated respiratory alkalosis. Renal function, electrolytes, and calcium are within normal limits. Clinical correlation is recommended, especially regarding symptoms of hypoglycemia and possible acid-base disturbances.
